findings.title: Allow independently authored closed serialization metadata without an original-resource or generic-algorithm gate
findings.impact: Blocks a standalone Linux constructor despite documented individual fields and selected-profile observations, conflating metadata encoding with proprietary resource redistribution and arbitrary resource generation
findings.required_change: Permit an immutable typed closed profile of individually sourced metadata and explicit scoped120/1/0/0 initialization; remove mandatory originalSET/provider or blanket licensing/generic hash-metrics generation blocker, retain actual generated-output interoperability and C implementation prerequisites. New research only for a specific discriminable unresolved supported-input question.
